artists.biography: Pop Will Eat Itself (also known as PWEI or The Poppies) are an English alternative rock band, originally formed in Stourbridge in 1986, with members from Birmingham, Coventry and the Black Country. Initially known as a Grebo act, their style changed to incorporate sample driven indie and industrial rock. Their highest charting single was 1993's "Get The Girl! Kill The Baddies!". After initially disbanding in 1996, and having a brief reformation in 2005, they issued their first release in over five years in 2010.

perplexity.description:
I need to clarify that "Karmadrome / Eat Me Drink Me Love Me Kill Me" was not released as a standalone album. Rather, "Karmadrome" and "Eat Me Drink Me Love Me Kill Me" were released as a double A-side single in 1992, appearing on Pop Will Eat Itself's fourth studio album The Looks or the Lifestyle?

The Looks or the Lifestyle? was released on 7 September 1992 by RCA Records and represented the band's continued exploration of electronic rock. Produced by London DJs Ben Wolff and Andy Dean (operating as Boilerhouse), the album was recorded at Rockfield Studios in Monmouthshire and mixed in London. The "Karmadrome" / "Eat Me Drink Me Love Me Kill Me" single, released as a double A-side in June 1992, reached number 17 on the UK Charts and served as the album's lead single. The album itself peaked at UK number 15 and featured additional Top 30 hit singles including "Bulletproof!"

Despite healthy sales and extensive touring, the album's commercial momentum was undermined by internal changes at RCA Records by early 1993, with remaining executives reportedly lacking understanding of the band's artistic direction. Nevertheless, The Looks or the Lifestyle? remains a significant entry in Pop Will Eat Itself's discography, showcasing their distinctive blend of electronic and rock elements during a period of relative commercial success for the band.
